projects.title: Runo Single-Session Hybrid Telephony
projects.tagline: Enabling in-app switching between SIM and cloud calling without logging out or resetting app sessions
projects.summary: Implemented an in-app hybrid telephony orchestration mode at Runo — enabling agents to switch between existing Cloud Virtual Calling and SIM Calling within a single active session without app re-initialization.

Exact reduction in re-login user friction

timeline.title: Problem Identified
timeline.description: Cloud telephony and SIM calling both existed in Runo, but switching required logging out and re-initializing the app.

timeline.title: Single-Session Orchestration Engine
timeline.description: Designed a hybrid session state model allowing in-app call-medium switching without session destruction.

timeline.title: In-App Selector & Analytics Shipped
timeline.description: Shipped CallMediumSelector (bottom sheet/web popup) and unified reporting filters.

projects.title: Runo Product Analytics & Amplitude Instrumentation
projects.tagline: A single tracking facade so the rest of the app never has to know which analytics backend it's hitting
projects.summary: Worked on a product analytics layer at Runo — Amplitude provider abstraction, event taxonomy, user/company traits, deduplication, and platform-aware tracking across auth, billing, CRM, and call workflows.
needsVerification: Whether 'ownership' of analytics strategy is an accurate public claim vs. 'contributed to'

timeline.title: Ad hoc tracking calls audited
timeline.description: Events were scattered across feature code with no shared identity, dedupe, or platform-awareness model.

timeline.title: ProductAnalytics facade built
timeline.description: AmplitudeProvider behind a single AnalyticsProvider contract, with structured user/company traits.

timeline.title: Deduplication and platform targeting tuned
timeline.description: Time-windowed dedupe and AnalyticsTargetPlatform detection rolled out across web and mobile.
